data.name: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
data.detailed_description:
What is DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing?

Fueled by the love for classic combat racers and motorsports, DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing combines realistic driving mechanics with weaponized combat madness. Take on the challenge to win the biggest underground racing competition in the new world.

You are to take part in the DIVEBOMB Torunaments that take you across the country over diverse landscapes. To become the ultimate combat racer. Taking place in a world where corporations are gradually building up to rule the world and governments losing power by the minute. DIVEBOMB, broadcast live for anyone to watch through the freenet, is the modern day gladiator arena where drivers not only have to drive fast to win, but have to fight to survive.

With simulated realistic driving physics, car control is the primary way to win, yet without properly utilizing the weapons and traps in your arsenal, you may not even reach the finish line.

Features

  • Realistic Physics Simulation - With realistic wheel, engine, transmission and suspension simulation, mastering every track requires focus and caution.

  • Weaponized Combat - Weapons ranging from low caliber lightweight machine guns, to large destructive miniguns or rocket launchers and traps that disrupt your driving lead to chaotic weaponized racing.

  • Collision Damage - Cars visually deform on impact, reflecting the brutal nature of weaponized racing.

  • Deep Customization - Ballistic armors, chassis reinforcements and weapons each with its combat advantages but weight disadvantages affecting anything from handling to braking distances, leading to endless strategy decisions.

  • Engaging Story - Start your journey in the world of DIVEBOMB with the DIVEBOMB Qualifiers, the beginning chapters of the story.

  • Tournaments - Compete across multi-event tournaments where every position counts toward overall championship glory.

  • Diverse Environment - From neglected, lawless regions of the Freelands to the glamorous, harsh corporate cities, race across diverse environments that require different driving styles based on terrain and layouts.

  • Diverse Cars - A growing roster of cars across three performance classes each fits a different driving style and has different performance metrics. Small sports cars reward more aggressive driving while large SUV's are easier to drive and are durable.

  • Tuning System - All cars are setup for balance from the factory. However every racer has a different driving style. Adjust parameters like brake balance, ride height, anti roll bar stiffness and differential lock to tailor any car to fit your driving style.

A Note From The Developer

As a solo developer passionate about classic combat racers and motorsports, DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing is my commitment to bringing the genre into the modern era. Your feedback directly shapes its future.

data.short_description: Physics-based driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 4th Generation

  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660

  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 9th Generation
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
